optional_single_retag_reduction.recommendation: Not preferred unless the product deliberately groups Radebeul into the Dresden metro. The current point already fits Dresden, but Radebeul is a distinct municipality and the staged city field is explicit.

grouping_conventions.slug_rule: ASCII lowercase identifiers; preserve native diacritics in name and label.
grouping_conventions.bbox_policy: Operational discovery/geocoder extents, not legal boundaries. Every candidate is inside its proposed bbox without relying on validator margin.
grouping_conventions.city_policy: Omit region (or set false) for 21 compact municipalities/cities.
grouping_conventions.region_policy: Use region:1 only for Vega (archipelago/destination area) and Tahko (resort area). Do not use region merely to make validation pass: tools/model.js gives regions a ±1.0° validation margin versus ±0.1° for cities.
grouping_conventions.country_policy: Ci has no explicit country field. The flag emoji e supplies country identity and flCountryName fallback; the trip planner separately uses flCO.
grouping_conventions.country_map_required_for_full_ui: Add the proposed flCO mappings so all new city/area slugs appear in the Plan-a-trip Country/City selectors.
grouping_conventions.flag_map_note: Moldova is not in the current flCountryFlag lookup; add it if chisinau is added to flCO so the selector shows a flag. All other proposed country names already exist in that flag map.

overlap_and_pitfall_review.reason: Sardinia is in Italy; the match is caused by bbox plus the gross 0.1° inference margin.
